title: About the trial you just finished
description: Please answer from what you actually did on this trial.

metadata.instrument: Content-based attention check doubling as a manipulation check.
metadata.citation: Prolific (2024), Attention and comprehension check policy — task-relevant checks preferred over generic traps; Meade & Craig (2012), Identifying careless responses in survey data, Psychological Methods 17(3), 437-455; Berinsky, Margolis & Sances (2014), Separating the shirkers from the workers?, AJPS 58(3), 739-753.
metadata.note: The fourth option is a lure and is never correct. Scored against the trial's assigned modality, so the answer varies by trial and by participant.

items.prompt: How did you teach the robot on this trial?
options: I drove the robot myself using the keyboard
I set sliders describing what mattered
I typed a sentence describing the task
I did not teach the robot on this trial
